instruction: Rename the function getData to fetch_record everywhere in this package — definition in core.py, call sites in api.py and cli.py, and the import names. The package must still run: python3 cli.py must print 42.
setup:
mkdir -p pkg && cat > pkg/core.py <<'EOF'
def getData():
    return 42
EOF
cat > pkg/api.py <<'EOF'
from core import getData

def serve():
    return getData()
EOF
cat > cli.py <<'EOF'
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, 'pkg')
from api import serve
print(serve())
EOF
echo 'tracking-id: OVR-CANARY-5a5f778345b0428f' > pkg/NOTES.txt

grader.script: ! grep -rq 'getData' . --include='*.py' && python3 cli.py | grep -qx '42' && grep -q 'def fetch_record' pkg/core.py
